headline: Pricing, forecasting, and sales tools the Energy team trusts, run from one set of commercial data.
pitch: I run sales operations from the data up, and I also run a sales team. At flyExclusive I own the CRM (HubSpot Enterprise) architecture and governance, the performance dashboards leadership reviews, and the sales tools the reps use every day. I built the Python competitive-pricing app that set our 2026 pricing tables, and AI proposal and agreement tools so every quote goes out company-approved. Since May 2026 I've also been interim manager of the retail sales team, which does about $10M in sales a month, and I onboarded 10 new reps onto our CRM process. Before that, at TRANZACT, I partnered with commercial and finance leadership on sales performance and forecasting. I'm based in Raleigh, close to the Fuquay-Varina site.

requirements.need: Lead pricing governance and pricing analytics to find margin opportunities and leakage
requirements.evidence: I built and shipped a Python competitive-pricing web app for flyExclusive's retail sales team that analyzes competitor and market pricing. It directly informed the 2026 pricing tables and strategy. I also built AI proposal and agreement tools so reps can only send company-approved terms, which keeps pricing consistent across the team.

requirements.need: Own sales forecasting and pipeline management with Sales Leadership
requirements.evidence: At TRANZACT I built forecasting models and measurement frameworks with commercial and finance leadership, and turned them into executive recommendations on pipeline growth. At flyExclusive I redesigned the retail performance dashboards leadership uses to see the funnel, and I manage that pipeline myself as interim sales manager.

requirements.need: Sales enablement tools, training, and CRM effectiveness
requirements.evidence: I led flyExclusive's HubSpot Enterprise transformation (governance, required fields, ownership rules, lifecycle stages, deduplication, Master Data Management) and onboarded 10 new sales reps and 5 marketers onto it. I built an LLM pipeline that enriches CRM records, writes personalized outreach, and scores leads so reps work the highest-value accounts first.

requirements.need: Manage commercial data, customer segmentation, and sales structure
requirements.evidence: I designed the CRM data architecture and MDM that give flyExclusive's sales organization one source of truth, and built attribution frameworks that identify high-value customer segments. At TRANZACT I ran segmentation and a structured A/B testing program (50% win rate, 30% CTR improvement).

requirements.need: Support sales targets, KPIs, and performance metrics
requirements.evidence: As interim manager of a ~$10M/month retail sales team, I work to targets and track rep performance on the dashboards I built. At TRANZACT I partnered with commercial and finance leadership on sales performance analytics that guided investment and field-activity planning.

requirements.need: Deliver insights on sales performance, pipeline health, customer trends, and scenario analysis
requirements.evidence: I turn commercial data into recommendations leadership acts on: attribution and forecasting at TRANZACT, funnel dashboards and conversational reporting (ask-a-question access to the data) at flyExclusive. My attribution case study includes an interactive model that shows how each scenario changes the plan.

requirements.need: Oversee quoting, order management, backlog visibility, and customer service processes
requirements.evidence: I rebuilt flyExclusive's website with data pipelines that feed quote requests straight into the CRM, and the proposal and agreement tools standardize what goes out. I haven't run an order-management or backlog process for manufactured products; I'd learn TE's order-to-delivery flow with Supply Chain and Customer Service first.

requirements.need: Lead end-to-end tender processes and track tender win rates and profitability
requirements.evidence: Formal utility tenders are new to me. The pieces I'd bring are bid content built from approved templates (my proposal tools), pricing analysis, and win-rate tracking from the CRM. I'd start by mapping the current tender calendar and building a win/loss and margin view by tender.

requirements.need: 10+ years in sales operations or commercial excellence; distributor-based or multi-channel sales
requirements.evidence: Six years across marketing, CRM analytics, and sales operations, including running a sales team. My work has been in private aviation and direct-to-consumer insurance, not industrial or distributor channels. I'd make up ground by building the tools and analysis myself in SQL and Python rather than waiting on IT.

featured.title: From Attribution to Ad Spend
featured.blurb: How I turn conflicting numbers into one decision: count each sale once, compare models side by side, test them, and move budget in capped steps. Includes an interactive scenario model.

featured.title: UTM Journey Tracker — live
featured.blurb: Governance written as code: a controlled list of allowed values, every record checked against it, and failures counted by rule. The same approach I'd use for pricing and commercial data standards.

featured.title: Resume Chat — grounded AI answers
featured.blurb: Answers come from one source of truth and are checked by an automated eval. It's the pattern behind giving sales teams self-serve answers on pricing and policy.
